description: BSM from UDOT and Panasonic Connected Vehicle Data Ecosystem Program is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Transit", published or maintained by U.S. Department of Transportation. This dataset contains V2X data collected from the Utah Connected Vehicle Data Ecosystem Program. We have submitted 7 days of deduplicated Basic Safety Messages (BSMs) in J2735 standards from 3 intersections in Orem, UT.This includes: (1) vehicles equipped with OBUs (Onboard Units) for real-time V2X (Vehicle-to-Everything) data transmission and reception, (2) road-side units (RSUs) capable ... Coverage: Orem, UT (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Transit". It has 120 columns, among them PATHPREDICTION_CONFIDENCE, AIR_TEMP, CURRGNSS_STATUS_ISMONITORED, VEHICLEALERTS_SIREN_USE, FRONT_WIPER_RATE, VERTICAL_ACCELERATION. The portal shows 2025-07-07 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
